column.description: Brief ready once the brief is complete and nothing material is open; Planned while you need an answer from the admin.

reply.description: A new comment in the thread: questions with options and your recommendation, or what changed. Null if there is nothing to say.

brief.description: The whole brief for the admin (Markdown), replacing the last one. Null leaves it as it is.

guidance.description: Instructions for the maker: angle, hook, what each slide leads with, the caption's shape, what to avoid. Numbers only from the source. Null only when brief is null.

use_images.description: Keys of the images the post uses (hero, subject-N, attachment-N). Leave one out to keep it off the post.

attached_images.description: Images the admin attached that you judged usable, with the credit their comments support. Each one counts as used.

for.description: hero (the cover and the Story), or the name of the subject it shows.

credit.description: The credit printed on the slide, e.g. 'Photo: Jo Baker'.

what.description: What it shows, in a few plain words, for the alt text.

image_lookups.description: Pictures to look for after this turn (at most six a card); what came back is shown on your next turn as found-N. Empty when the post has what it needs.

subject.description: Who or what the picture is of: hero, or a subject's name.

query.description: page: the page's address (empty for the source's own); wikimedia: what to search for; business_discovery: the Instagram handle.

slides.description: In order. A carousel: 3 to 10, a cover first and a cta last. A Story: 1 to 3 story frames.

brief.description: What this slide says and leads with, for the maker.

post.description: Only when the card has no template: your slide plan, which the maker follows once approved. Null otherwise, and null keeps the last one.
